Король и Месье поднялись следом за нею и сели подле неё."},{"source_id":"id07414","target":"— Идёмте, Лапорт, — сказала королева."},{"source_id":"id07415","target":"— Как, сударыня! — сказал камердинер. — В одной карете с Вашими Величествами?"},{"source_id":"id07416","target":"— Сегодня вечером дело не в королевском этикете, а в спасении короля. Садитесь, Лапорт!"},{"source_id":"id07417","target":"Лапорт повиновался."},{"source_id":"id07418","target":"— Закройте занавеси, — сказал д’Артаньян."},{"source_id":"id07419","target":"— Но не вызовет ли это недоверия, сударь? — спросила королева."},{"source_id":"id07420","target":"— Пусть Ваше Величество будет спокойно, — сказал д’Артаньян, — у меня ответ наготове."},{"source_id":"id07421","target":"Занавеси закрыли, и карета помчалась галопом по улице Ришелье. Когда подъехали к воротам, начальник караула вышел вперёд во главе дюжины человек, держа в руке фонарь."},{"source_id":"id07422","target":"Д’Артаньян знаком подозвал его."},{"source_id":"id07423","target":"— Узнаёте эту карету? — спросил он сержанта."},{"source_id":"id07424","target":"— Нет, — ответил тот."},{"source_id":"id07425","target":"— Взгляните на герб."},{"source_id":"id07426","target":"Сержант поднёс фонарь к дверце."},{"source_id":"id07427","target":"— Это герб господина коадъютора! — сказал он."},{"source_id":"id07428","target":"— Тсс! У него любовное приключение с госпожой де Гемене."},{"source_id":"id07429","target":"Сержант рассмеялся."},{"source_id":"id07430","target":"— Откройте ворота, — сказал он, — я знаю, в чём дело."}],"review":[{"source_id":"id07411","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Exclamation, speaker, and the step back are all preserved. Idiomatic."},{"source_id":"id07412","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful to 'montez hardiment' and to d'Artagnan's emphatic 'c'est moi qui le conduis'. Dialogue punctuation is correct."},{"source_id":"id07413","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction is verified. The cry of surprise, the order of boarding, and 'à ses côtés' are all rendered. Monsieur is correctly the king's brother."},{"source_id":"id07414","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate invitation to Laporte; the speaker is preserved."},{"source_id":"id07415","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction is verified. 'Vos Majestés' is now addressed to the queen and the king, as in the source, and the surprised tone is kept."},{"source_id":"id07416","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The contrast between 'étiquette royale' and 'salut du roi' is kept, as is the imperative. Correct."},{"source_id":"id07417","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate."},{"source_id":"id07418","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The command to close the carriage blinds ('mantelets') is rendered acceptably as 'занавеси', and the same term is used consistently in later rows."},{"source_id":"id07419","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction is verified. 'Défiance' becomes 'недоверие', and the negative interrogative is preserved."},{"source_id":"id07420","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The prior correction is verified. The agreement with 'Ваше Величество' is fixed and the confident reply is kept."},{"source_id":"id07421","verdict":"PASS","reason":"All actions are preserved: curtains closed, gallop down rue de Richelieu, the guard commander advancing with about a dozen men and a lantern. The impersonal 'on' is handled idiomatically."},{"source_id":"id07422","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate, with the same agent and gesture."},{"source_id":"id07423","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate question to the sergeant."},{"source_id":"id07424","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate negative answer."},{"source_id":"id07425","verdict":"PASS","reason":"'Les armes' means the coat of arms on the carriage, so 'герб' is correct."},{"source_id":"id07426","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Lantern brought to the door panel, where the arms are painted. Accurate."},{"source_id":"id07427","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The arms are identified as the coadjutor's, as in the source."},{"source_id":"id07428","verdict":"PASS","reason":"The conspiratorial 'Chut!' and the ironic 'en bonne fortune' (a love affair) are preserved, with the name of Madame de Guéménée."},{"source_id":"id07429","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Accurate."},{"source_id":"id07430","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Order to open the gate and the sergeant's knowing remark are preserved."}]}
